📢 Financial Literacy Program for Underprivileged Women

The Rotary Club of Mumbai Ghatkopar West, in collaboration with Suryoday Foundation, successfully conducted a Financial Literacy Program for underprivileged women at two locations on 2nd September 2026.

The initiative focused on creating awareness about financial planning, savings, banking, budgeting, and making informed financial decisions. The sessions aimed to equip women with practical knowledge to manage their finances confidently and work towards greater financial independence.

✨ A total of 90 women participated in the program, making it a meaningful and impactful initiative towards financial awareness and women’s empowerment.

We sincerely thank Suryoday Foundation, our members, volunteers, and everyone who supported the initiative and helped make the program a success. 🙏🌸

Together, creating lasting impact through financial awareness and empowerment. 💙
